en.title: US Air Force adds funding for Joby's autonomous cargo aircraft, taking commitment near $37 million
en.summary: Joby Aviation has received additional US Air Force funding through AFWERX for its autonomous flight technology, bringing the service's cumulative commitment to nearly $37 million, with further operational testing planned in the Pacific region.
body: Joby Aviation announced on November 4 that the US Air Force had provided additional funding for its autonomous flight technology through AFWERX, taking the service's cumulative commitment to nearly $37 million. The funding will support further development of autonomous software and additional operational testing in the Pacific region, including military exercises.

The ceiling on Joby's autonomous logistics and cargo test contract has been raised to $50 million. A Pentagon contract announcement on September 28 confirmed a $45 million increase in that ceiling but committed no new funding at the time, and contract work is expected to run through March 1, 2029. Joby's autonomous technology, acquired with Xwing's autonomy division in June 2024, has now completed more than 400 fully autonomous flights, and the company is also preparing a dedicated defence business after agreeing in August to acquire Resonant Sciences for about $500 million, a deal expected to close in early 2027.

zh.title: 美空軍加碼Joby自主貨運機計畫累計承諾近3700萬美元
zh.summary: Joby航空透過AFWERX獲得美國空軍新增資金，用於自主飛行技術，使美空軍累計承諾接近3700萬美元，後續將在太平洋地區進行更多作戰測試。
body: Joby航空11月4日宣布，美國空軍透過AFWERX為其自主飛行技術提供新增資金，使美空軍對該技術的累計承諾接近3700萬美元。這筆資金將用於進一步開發自主軟體，並在太平洋地區進行更多作戰測試，包括軍事演習。
Joby自主物流與貨運測試合約的上限已提高至5000萬美元；五角大廈9月28日的合約公告確認上限增加4500萬美元，但當時未承諾新增資金，合約工作預計持續至2029年3月1日。Joby的自主技術源自2024年6月收購Xwing自主部門，至今已完成逾400次全自主飛行；公司另於8月同意以約5億美元收購ResonantSciences，預計2027年初完成交易，藉此籌組專門的國防業務。
